security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A small desktop companion that answers questions about what's on your screen
bundle.longDescription: mouce sits on your desktop and lets you chat with an AI, ask about your screen, circle anything to look it up, find word meanings with Ctrl + right-click, and keep a calendar with reminders. It can run fully on your computer with Ollama, or with an online AI you choose.
